module_summary: Combinational 16-bit adder built from two chained 8-bit ripple-carry adders, the low byte's carry-out feeding the high byte's carry-in.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: 16-bit operand A split into low and high bytes.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: 16-bit operand B split into low and high bytes.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: 16-bit sum assembled from both 8-bit adder outputs.

anchors.name: Co_temp
anchors.why: Inter-byte carry chaining low adder to high adder.

groups.name: low_byte_adder
groups.description: 8-bit adder for bits 7:0 producing the inter-byte carry.

groups.name: high_byte_adder
groups.description: 8-bit adder for bits 15:8 consuming the inter-byte carry.
